title: A Spectral Confirmation of the Erdős Matching Conjecture
summary: The Erdős Matching Conjecture concerns the maximum number of hyperedges in an $r$-uniform hypergraph with bounded matching number. In this paper, we study a spectral counterpart of this conjecture. For sufficiently large $n$, we determine the maximum spectral radius over all $n$-vertex $r$-uniform hypergraphs whose matching number is less than $s$, and characterize the unique extremal hypergraph.
